metadata.title: Optimal asymptotic bounds for design curves on manifolds
metadata.abstract: A spherical $t$-design is a finite set of points on the $d$-dimensional unit sphere such that averaging any polynomial of degree at most $t$ over these points gives its exact spherical average. We study the corresponding notion for curves, where point averages are replaced by normalized arclength integration. For fixed $d\ge 2$, the length of such curves is known to be bounded below by a positive multiple of $t^{d-1}$ as $t\to\infty$. We show that this asymptotic order is attained: for every $d\ge 2$, there exists a constant $C_d>0$ such that, for every positive integer $t$ and every prescribed length $L\ge C_dt^{d-1}$, there is a simple spherical $t$-design curve of length $L$. This establishes the analogue for curves of the theorem of Bondarenko, Radchenko, and Viazovska, which resolved the Korevaar-Meyers conjecture for spherical design points. More generally, we prove the corresponding result on closed, connected Riemannian manifolds of dimension $d\ge 2$, where eigenfunctions of the Laplace-Beltrami operator substitute for polynomials. The proof combines a geometric construction of curves with continuously adjustable local lengths and an application of Brouwer's degree theorem.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 设计曲线的最优渐近长度阶
analysis.workSummary: 对固定d≥2、每个正整数t，存在C_d，使每个指定L≥C_dt^{d−1}都可由长度恰L的简单球面t-design曲线实现，其归一化弧长积分对次数≤t多项式精确等于球面平均。这达到已知长度下界的渐近阶，并推广到闭连通d维黎曼流形，以Laplace–Beltrami本征函数取代多项式。
techniques: 局部长度可连续调节的曲线构造
analysis.breakthrough: 在无自交曲线类实现最优长度增长阶，并允许阈值以上任意指定长度。
analysis.limitations: 阶最优不等于C_d最优；维数需≥2且一般流形闭连通。摘要未给一般谱设计的频率—长度精确对应，不能直接照搬球面t指数解释。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
